caption: The drawing displays a wooden chest of drawers consisting of four rows of drawers, each adorned with geometric and raised decorative panels in shades of brown. The chest stands on four spherical, dark brown legs, one at each corner. Each drawer features two metal keyholes with handles, rendered in a muted green color. The drawers are framed with vertical spindle-like columns, and the front surfaces are decorated with a mixture of rectangular, triangular, and octagonal wood patterns, varying slightly per row. The edges of the top surface have a sawtooth border detail. The side panels of the chest show simple rectangular outlines, emphasizing the grain of the wood. The background is plain and uncolored, with a faint rectangular border enclosing the subject. The artist’s name, "P.L. Johnson," is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Chest of Drawers
